already_taught.speaker: Teacher Ana
already_taught.text: You've already learned the basics well. Keep practicing at the dock!

ready_to_turn_in.speaker: Teacher Ana
ready_to_turn_in.text: You caught a fish and answered correctly - wonderful work! Here's something for your effort.

in_progress.speaker: Teacher Ana
in_progress.text: Have you tried fishing at the dock yet? Answer the questions there to prove what you've learned.

choices.text: Can you remind me what to look for?

reminder.speaker: Teacher Ana
reminder.text: Fresh fish should have clear eyes, firm flesh, and be kept properly iced. Spoiled fish smells strong and has cloudy eyes.

first_meeting.speaker: Teacher Ana
first_meeting.text: Welcome! I teach proper post-harvest fish handling - how to keep your catch fresh and safe. Want to learn?

accept_quest.speaker: Teacher Ana
accept_quest.text: Wonderful! Head to the dock and answer a few questions while you fish - that's how you'll show me what you've learned. I'll also give you something to help you get started.
